# @trysac/correlation-id

> Framework-agnostic correlation id middleware for node:http with W3C Trace Context traceparent parsing, AsyncLocalStorage context and Express and Fastify adapters. TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage example and API summary
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions and limits for contributors and agents

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): test file and coverage
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and practices
- [Decisions](docs/decisions/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md): architecture decision records
